Indian athletes win medals in gymnastics and athletics championships

Indian athletes achieved significant success across multiple international sports events. Ariha Pangambam secured India's first gold medal in the Asian Aerobic Gymnastics Championships. In the World Athletics U20 Championships, Basant Kumar Meghwal won a silver medal in the high jump, marking India's first high jump medal at this event. Shahnavaz also secured a bronze medal in the long jump at the same championships. Separately, Anahat Singh is preparing for senior-level competitions including the Asian Games and Olympics.
